sources.note: The August 10, 2026 release still lists Baton Rouge among the six Tallvine-backed Velocity locations, supporting current integration and no later exit.

sources.label: Legacy BTR Jet Center site
sources.note: Supports the historic brand/address and distinguishes BTR Air Charter as a sister company. It does not establish that the air-charter company was acquired.

conclusion: The PROPOSED_MERGE decision is supported without source substitutions. BTR Jet Center is a closed add-on and current Baton Rouge operating location beneath Tallvine-owned Velocity FBO Network. The official lease assignments identify the local assignee, current Velocity materials establish integration, and no subsequent ownership change was found through the cutoff. BTR Air Charter remains outside the merge absent direct acquisition evidence.
